entities.summary: Andrey Mitrofanovich Kizhevatov was a Soviet border guard commander, one of the leaders of the Defense of Brest Fortress during Operation Barbarossa, head of the 9th frontier post of the 17th Brest border detachment of the People's Commissariat of Internal Affairs (NKVD).
